quest.title: Investigator of Ancient Ruins
quest.description: One wonders if there are any clues to be found for entering the Great Volcano of Tollan amidst these crumbling ruins...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.text: We're so... *panting* We're so grateful for your... assistance... Those monsters came out of... came out of nowhere, and... dealing with them just... *panting* takes so much time...

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: You... You came just in time... I'm Kimosi, from the Collective of Plenty and this... *panting* this is Nzaya... Okay, just give me a moment to catch my breath...

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: If you care so much about time, Kimosi, it might be a good idea to work on your muscles a little more.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Haha! Never gonna happen. I'm just not cut out for the battlefield... or for getting ripped. I prefer finding shortcuts to deal with my foes.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: We'll report back to the tribe and get them to send backup. That should improve our efficiency, increase safety, and...

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: ...Save time. I've heard you say it so many times my brain is sore. The only time you don't care how long something takes is when you're telling stories — then you can keep talking from dusk till dawn.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: That's the whole point of saving time in the first place! So I can spend it on things I enjoy... Oh, we mustn't forget about our guests...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uhh... I take it you're "Uncle Kimosi"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon was just thinking that name sounded familiar!

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: #Uncle? As I recall, I only have the one nephew... My goodness, Dutse, look how you've grown! Why, you've blossomed into a {M#handsome young specimen of a man}{F#charming young specimen of a woman}!

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: Cut the nonsense, Kimosi. If this was your unruly little imp of a nephew, I'd eat a hat.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, I was just having a little fun.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: In any case, I really must thank you again for coming to our rescue. May I ask, what are the two— no, three of you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe. Paimon's Paimon, and {M#he's}{F#she's} {NICKNAME}! And this is our little companion, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Your Tepetlisaurus friend looks like a remarkable fellow, just like... just like a human. He even has his own clothes...

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: If a scarf counts as an article of clothing, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: On you, I'm not sure it would. But on this little guy, that's exactly what it is...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrawr?

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: That's where we fall short of saurians, I'm afraid. Hey, Nzaya, take a look at his horn...

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Are you going to the volcano, then?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? How did you know where we're headed!?

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Aha, and this is where smart, time-saving people show their worth. Now, let me guess what you're up to...

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: You want to enter the volcano as well, right... It's possible, and I know the way. I could even tell you...

choices.text: But?

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Haha! I see you're a smart person too.

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Not far from here is an area containing Remnants of the Secret Source known as the Tephric Ruins... Let me explain...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Long, long ago... back when Natlan was still a peaceful paradise...

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: Ah, actually, it was 500 years ago, just as the Abyssal corrosion in Natlan was at its worst — an entire section of ruins was spat out by the volcano.

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Hey now, do you not feel even a little guilty interrupting other people's stories?

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: I'm just saving time, Kimosi. This is hardly the moment for storytelling — we're right in the middle of investigating the recent thefts at the Tephric Ruins.

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: A witness from our tribe claims they saw one of the Qucusaurs that dwell nearby carrying off a statue from the ruins... We're here to find out what the situation is.

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: But when we arrived, the whole ruin was crawling with Abyssal monsters. So I'm wondering... Could you maybe help us clean them out?

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: If you can deal with the monsters, then Nzaya and I won't have to return to the tribe, and we can... save time.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrrawr?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, you want us to go to these Tephric Ruins with you?

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Nzaya and I will follow you there, but we won't take part in any fighting — not unless you end up in real trouble...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Of course, you don't have to help, but in that case, my knowledge of how to enter the volcano will have to stay with me.

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: If you run into danger, I'll guarantee your safety... But, as for the road into the volcano, I won't tell you, and it's not up for debate.

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: I have to be certain that you have the ability to deal with those monsters first.

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: Wait a moment, Kimosi, I'm not sure I understand. Surely, if we all work together, we can save even more time?

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: #That is indeed true, but in this case... "safety" comes first. I'm sure you understand, my {M#handsome young specimen of a man}{F#charming young specimen of a woman}.

choices.text: Just a few monsters. No big deal.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, it's only a few monsters. Stand back and watch. We'll be all like "pew-pew" and they'll be gone in no time!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: You're certainly full of confidence... We'll stand back and see how you do.

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: You strike me as powerful warriors, but don't push yourselves too hard... Kimosi likes to yammer on, but he said one thing worth listening to just now...

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: Safety does come first. It's more important than saving time. In fact, it's way more important than anything else.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, don't worry about us — we've got this!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

choices.text: Perfectly! I accept the challenge.
There's always a "but" in sentences like this...

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: Are things alright...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All the monsters have been cleared out!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: I'm more concerned with whether you were wounded or not. Wounds from Abyssal monsters can have severe consequences if not treated properly.

choices.text: Not so much as a scratch.

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: That's good to hear...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: #To clean out all the Abyssal monsters in the Tephric Ruins so quickly... It looks like you're even stronger than I thought, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Even stronger than the rumors say.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, you've heard of us?

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: Huh, we've heard of them?

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: You spend too much time focusing on your muscles. If you took a break every now and then to chat with the couriers from the Scions of the Canopy, you might have a better idea who we're talking to...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Hmm... Did you see a statue? It should have been in the middle of the large platform in the ruins...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Grroo...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: I guess it must be missing... We'll just have to look for it later...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Enough chitchat. Seeing as you've shown that you're more than capable of dealing with the Abyss, it's time to uphold my end of the bargain. So. If you want to enter the volcano...

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: Hold up. What does dealing with the Abyss have to do with entering the volcano?

choices.text: The Abyss must have a presence inside...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Exactly! And based on the condition of objects recently ejected from the volcano, it's clear that the Abyssal corrosion has gotten worse.

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Not everyone on the exploration team made it back... I still remember a monster disguising itself as one of my companions in distress...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: #Either way, {NICKNAME}, it's an incredibly dangerous place. Are you sure you want to go there knowing that?

choices.text: I'm certain...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Alright... The way in is simple, but by no means easy. To cut to the chase, you'll need to jump in through the crater.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Through... the crater?

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Do you see those floating rocks around the crater? Phlogiston's gaseous state causes them to float there during eruptions...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: The end result is what's known as the "Skyfire{RUBY#[D]Nahuatzin's Springboard} Circlet"... I'm not sure who came up with that name, but it could do with a bit of work.

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: If you climb to the highest point on the Skyfire Circlet, you should be facing the volcano's crater directly. The crater is filled with unstable gaseous Phlogiston, which forms something of a wall...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: But, haha, I'm sure you'll be able to find a way to jump down through it!

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: Really? Didn't you tell me that very few people outside the Flower-Feather Clan have ever made it through...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: I'm just explaining the way. As to the means our intrepid travelers take to get there... Well, that's got nothing to do with me!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrrwar? Mrrroo?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's an earthquake... Wait, no — the volcano's erupting!

choices.text: We've already made our minds up, so...
It was an excuse to get me to do his work for him...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: #As I'm sure you realized when I offered you this deal, my {M#handsome young specimen of a man}{F#charming young specimen of a woman}. That said, there are indeed a large number of these pitch-black monsters inside the volcano...

choices.text: Just a teensy bit upset you didn't help out...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: All the more proof that you didn't need our help.

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: And there are rumors that the space inside the volcano is unique... Perhaps even the shadowy hands of the Lord of the Night cannot reach inside...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: If you climb to the highest point on the Skyfire Circlet, you should be facing the volcano's crater directly. The crater is filled with unstable gaseous Phlogiston, which forms something of a wall...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: But, haha, I'm sure you'll be able to find a way to jump down through it!

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: Really? Didn't you tell me that very few people outside the Flower-Feather Clan have ever made it through...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: I'm just explaining the way. As to the means our intrepid travelers take to get there... Well, that's got nothing to do with me!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrrwar? Mrrroo?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's an earthquake... Wait, no — the volcano's erupting!

choices.text: We've already made our minds up, so...
It was an excuse to get me to do his work for him...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: #As I'm sure you realized when I offered you this deal, my {M#handsome young specimen of a man}{F#charming young specimen of a woman}. That said, there are indeed a large number of these pitch-black monsters inside the volcano...

choices.text: Just a teensy bit upset you didn't help out...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: All the more proof that you didn't need our help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah! The volcano erupted again. Seriously, every time that happens, Paimon's heart jumps out her chest!

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Haha, for those of us in the Collective of Plenty, we hardly even notice anymore. Still, you've always got to be on the lookout for things falling from the sky...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, so we need to find a way up to that Skyfire Circlet, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Precisely... Anyway, we've fulfilled our end of the bargain. Nzaya, I think it's about time we got going.

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: Huh, you're not going with them?

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: The volcano isn't somewhere that someone like me has any business going near. Not to mention, Abyssal monsters turning up in the ruins is something we'll need to report to the tribe.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, don't worry about it! Now that we know how to get in, we'll take it from here!

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: I wish you a smooth journey. After all, a smooth journey means getting in quick and getting out quicker, and being quick...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Saves time!

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: That's right! Haha.

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: One last thing — Safety. Comes. First!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Understood!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The "Tephric Ruins," huh... Kinda hard to imagine a ruin erupting from a volcano in one solid chunk...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a minute... Doesn't that mean there could still be more ruins inside?

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: We're so... *panting* We're so grateful for your... assistance... Those monsters came out of... came out of nowhere, and... dealing with them just... *panting* takes so much time...

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: You... You came just in time... I'm Kimosi, from the Collective of Plenty and this... *panting* this is Nzaya... Okay, just give me a moment to catch my breath...

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: If you care so much about time, Kimosi, it might be a good idea to work on your muscles a little more.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Haha! Never gonna happen. I'm just not cut out for the battlefield... or for getting ripped. I prefer finding shortcuts to deal with my foes.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: We'll report back to the tribe and get them to send backup. That should improve our efficiency, increase safety, and...

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: ...Save time. I've heard you say it so many times my brain is sore. The only time you don't care how long something takes is when you're telling stories — then you can keep talking from dusk till dawn.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: That's the whole point of saving time in the first place! So I can spend it on things I enjoy... Oh, we mustn't forget about our guests...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Uhh... I take it you're "Uncle Kimosi"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon was just thinking that name sounded familiar!

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: #Uncle? As I recall, I only have the one nephew... My goodness, Dutse, look how you've grown! Why, you've blossomed into a {M#handsome young specimen of a man}{F#charming young specimen of a woman}!

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: Cut the nonsense, Kimosi. If this was your unruly little imp of a nephew, I'd eat a hat.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Oh, come on, I was just having a little fun.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: In any case, I really must thank you again for coming to our rescue. May I ask, what are the two— no, three of you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe. Paimon's Paimon, and {M#he's}{F#she's} {NICKNAME}! And this is our little companion, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Your Tepetlisaurus friend looks like a remarkable fellow, just like... just like a human. He even has his own clothes...

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: If a scarf counts as an article of clothing, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: On you, I'm not sure it would. But on this little guy, that's exactly what it is...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrawr?

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: That's where we fall short of saurians, I'm afraid. Hey, Nzaya, take a look at his horn...

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Are you going to the volcano, then?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? How did you know where we're headed!?

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Aha, and this is where smart, time-saving people show their worth. Now, let me guess what you're up to...

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: You want to enter the volcano, but you don't know how!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, and that's where you'd be wrong. We already know how to do that!

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Haha, I see. So you're a smart person too... In which case, I have a matter I'd like to discuss with you, warriors who wish to enter the volcano. Do you have the time?

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Not far from here is an area containing Remnants of the Secret Source known as the Tephric Ruins... Let me explain...

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Long, long ago... back when Natlan was still a peaceful paradise...

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: Ah, actually, it was 500 years ago, just as the Abyssal corrosion in Natlan was at its worst — an entire section of ruins was spat out by the volcano.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Hey now, do you not feel even a little guilty interrupting other people's stories?

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: I'm just saving time, Kimosi. This is hardly the moment for storytelling — we're right in the middle of investigating the recent thefts at the Tephric Ruins.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: A witness from our tribe claims they saw one of the Qucusaurs that dwell nearby carrying off a statue from the ruins... We're here to find out what the situation is.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: But when we arrived, the whole ruin was crawling with Abyssal monsters. So I'm wondering... Could you maybe help us clean them out?

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: If you can deal with the monsters, then Nzaya and I won't have to return to the tribe, and we can... save time.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrawr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, you want us to go to these Tephric Ruins with you?

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Nzaya and I will follow you there, but we won't take part in any fighting.

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: Huh? But Kimosi, I'm not sure I understand. Surely, if we all work together, we can save even more time?

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: #Only the strongest warriors would dare to enter the volcano — amateurs like us would only hold them back. Safety comes first. I'm sure you can understand, my {M#handsome young specimen of a man}{F#charming young specimen of a woman}.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Of course, if there's a need for the two of us to get involved...

choices.text: It's just a few monsters. No big deal.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph, it's only a few monsters. Stand back and watch. We'll be all like "pew-pew" and they'll be gone in no time!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: You're certainly full of confidence... We'll stand back and see how you do.

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: You strike me as powerful warriors, but don't push yourselves too hard... Kimosi likes to yammer on, but he said one thing worth listening to just now...

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: Safety does come first. It's more important than saving time. In fact, it's way more important than anything else.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, don't worry about us — we've got this!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

choices.text: Perfectly! I accept the challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: Are things alright...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All the monsters have been cleared out!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: I'm more concerned with whether you were wounded or not. Wounds from Abyssal monsters can have severe consequences if not treated properly.

choices.text: Not so much as a scratch.

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: That's good to hear...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: #To clean out all the Abyssal monsters in the Tephric Ruins so quickly... It looks like you're even stronger than I thought, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Even stronger than the rumors say.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, you've heard of us?

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: Huh, we've heard of them?

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: You spend too much time focusing on your muscles. If you took a break every now and then to chat with the couriers from the Scions of the Canopy, you might have a better idea who we're talking to...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Hmm... Did you see a statue? It should have been in the middle of the large platform in the ruins...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Grroo...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: I guess it must be missing... We'll just have to look for it later...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: You have our gratitude, warriors. Thanks to you, we can finally complete our investigation and report back to the tribe.

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: I wish you a smooth journey. After all, a smooth journey means you can quickly reach your target, and quickness...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Saves time!

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Exactly!

response.speaker: Nzaya

response.text: And that's when we discovered all these Abyssal monsters crawling out of the woodwork...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Grroo...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: No? Well, that could pose a problem. The relics inside the ancient Remnants of the Secret Source are incredibly valuable, and they were deliberately placed in this section of ruins...

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: It's impossible to know for sure where that Qucusaurus has taken it, so we'll just have to look for it later... Though speaking of nearby Qucusaurus dwellings...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: Hmm... It may well be on the Skyfire Circlet...

response.speaker: Kimosi
response.text: You have our gratitude, warriors. Thanks to you, we can finally complete our investigation and report back to the tribe.

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: #Indeed, thank you so much for your assistance. Who knows what we'd have done without the great {NICKNAME}, Paimon, and their saurian friend!

response.speaker: Nzaya
response.text: May we meet again!

choices.text: Fire away!

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: Huh? What happened to the pitch-black monsters that were here... Did you defeat them all? That's fantastic news! Why, all the time you've saved...

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: It looks like our luck's come in, Nzaya!

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: That's not a very "tribal warrior" thing to say, Kimosi... Was it you who cleared out all the Abyssal monsters here?

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: You weren't wounded, were you? Wounds from Abyssal monsters can have severe consequences if not treated properly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not so much as a scratch.

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: That's good to hear...

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: In any case, I really must thank you again for coming to our rescue. May I ask, what are the two— no, three of you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hehe. Paimon's Paimon, and {M#he's}{F#she's} {NICKNAME}! And this is our little companion, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Wonderful! Your Tepetlisaurus friend looks like a remarkable fellow, just like... just like a human. He even has his own clothes...

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: If a scarf counts as an article of clothing, anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Nzaya
dialogues.text: On you, I'm not sure it would. But on this little guy, that's exactly what it is...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrawr?

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: That's where we fall short of saurians, I'm afraid. Hey, Nzaya, take a look at his horn...

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Are you going to the volcano, then?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right. We're gonna enter the volcano... and we already know how!

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: Is that so? Well color me impressed...

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: So you want to enter the volcano... Hmm, it's a dangerous place, though...

dialogues.speaker: Kimosi
dialogues.text: You were able to clear out all the Abyssal monsters and come away unscathed, so you can clearly handle yourselves... But, brave warriors, there's something I want to ask you first.

choices.text: Need help with something else?

response.speaker: Kimosi

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nice! Looks like we've beaten all the monsters within these Tephric Ruins!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, you're excited too, huh, little guy... Let's head back and report to Kimosi and company.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Y'know, we might be able to use the Spiritways created by the volcanic eruptions to climb up to the Skyfire Circlet...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, y'think so too? Let's give it a shot, then!
